newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Global Carriers plans 3:2 bonus, 5:1 rights.
newsitem.headline: Global Carriers plans 3:2 bonus, 5:1 rights.

text.p: Malaysian shipping firm Global Carriers Bhd announced it was planning a bonus issue in the ratio of three shares for every two held in the company.
The company is also planning a rights issue in the ratio of five shares for every one held at present, it said in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
The rights issue would be at a price of two ringgit a share. The bonus issue would capitalise around 30 million ringgit of the company's reserves.
It also proposed an employees share option scheme of up to 10 percent of the company's share capital after the rights and bonus issues.
The proceeds from the issues will be used to repay bank borrowings and finance construction of new ships, it said.
